method: Three-fold StratifiedGroupKFold; optimize three bounded additive log-probability offsets on two folds and evaluate on the held-out fold. Identity is retained if fit objective does not improve.
limitations: Cross-fitting guards bias-fitting overfit only. Base checkpoints and the ensemble were already selected using this validation set; this remains exploratory, not an untouched test estimate. Free offsets are an adaptation motivated by logit-adjustment research, not an exact reproduction of frequency-based logit adjustment.
